## Summary / 摘要

<!-- One or two sentences: what does this PR do and why? -->

## Related Issue / 相關 Issue

<!-- e.g., Closes #123, Refs #456. If no issue exists for non-trivial changes, please open one first. -->

## Type of Change / 變更類型

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change that adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that changes existing behavior)
- [ ] 📚 Documentation only
- [ ] ♻️ Refactor (no behavior change)
- [ ] 🔧 Build / tooling / CI

## How Tested / 測試方式

<!-- How did you verify this works? Manual steps, automated tests, screenshots? -->

- [ ] Backend tests pass (`pytest` if applicable)
- [ ] Frontend builds without errors (`npm run build`)
- [ ] Manually verified the affected pages / API endpoints

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the style guide in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] No hardcoded user-facing strings (used message codes / i18n)
- [ ] No `print()` (backend) or `alert()` (frontend) — used `logger` / `useMessage()`
- [ ] No secrets / credentials / internal hostnames committed
- [ ] Updated `CHANGELOG.md` under `[Unreleased]` if user-visible
- [ ] Updated relevant documentation
